history.content: ok so i was cleaning out my parents garage today and found a box of my old demo cds from this band i was in at like 19. cringe but also kind of amazing lol
Cringe and kind of amazing sounds like a very real mix. I’m curious whether one part of that hit as embarrassment, or whether it was more like surprise at running into an old version of you?
no honestly not embarrassed at all, thats the weird part. i put it on expecting to laugh and it actually sorta slaps?? like 19 year old me had it kinda figured out lol
That feels more like delight with a little surprise in it. Nineteen-year-old you getting to sound better than expected is a pretty sweet twist.

yeah. theres a flip side tho. we all just... stopped. everyone got jobs and moved and i kinda just let it die without even noticing? so im proud of it and also like, oof, what was i thinking giving that up
I’m holding both, then, pride and that “oof” of regret can sit together here. Did they feel side by side, or is the regret sitting underneath the pride?

ha the regrets def underneath. like the pride is the loud one. the sad bit only shows up when i think about the fact that the cd has a song on it i genuinely cant write anymore, idk how to explain it. ill spare you the whole midlife crisis tho
The pride is the loud one, and the sad bit only showing up around that song has a very specific edge to it. You can spare me the whole midlife crisis, or say a little more if you want.

i think its just that the song came from being 19 and broke and convinced wed make it, and i cant fake that feeling now. but honestly hearing it again felt less like grief and more like, oh there you are. proud of that kid. thats enough crying into a garage box for one day lol
That “oh, there you are” feels like a real homecoming to that kid. And “proud of that kid” lands like the part that wants to let it rest here for today.
yeah lets leave it there. oh there you are is exactly it. thanks, this helped more than a garage cleanout had any right to. gonna go rip these to mp3 before they crumble lol
I’m glad we found the words for it, and may the mp3 mission go smoothly.
